title: Spiked address ring

techniques.name: Record atlas ring

finish.label: Finish
finish.note: The page’s three renderings: 1 engraving, 2 by number, 3 thermal field.

field.label: Field variation
field.note: The page’s field-variation slider: stirs the color inside the cut contour; the held coordinates stay put.

turn.label: Turn
turn.note: Which of the record’s ten turns of 42 crossings the ring shows.

techniques.implementation: A soft multi-stop gradient fills a card cut to an arch, a step or a notch; a large number sits in the cut. Drawn by the source page’s own code; each dial sets one of the page’s own controls.

techniques.name: Measured inks
techniques.implementation: solid ink pixels of each figure, read at full resolution, are clustered to five colors; a color is kept when it holds at least 4% of the ink.

techniques.name: Figure and ground
techniques.implementation: The ground is the most common border color of a figure; ink is every pixel more than 40 levels from it.

pass_order: read · points measured from the figure
